protocol.policy: Original 120-source family split. Verify cached normalized RGB8 pixels and pinned native stream against the prior approved source and artifact hashes. Fresh first-party effort-7 encoding in an isolated process for every source. Fresh pinned libjxl and jxl-rs exact decodes for every new stream. No new native timing claim.

aggregation: One image per vote; arithmetic midpoint median for even counts; nearest-rank p90; every failed case retained. Class summaries do not replace the complete-cohort result.
qualification: This report checks only its declared cohort size and independent exactness. Separate held-out, high-depth/alpha, baseline-reduction, resource and performance evidence is required for full milestone qualification.
